stack.label: Two teleport staves, recall scroll at home
stack.explanation: Original: by the second trial (adding a staff beside the scroll) the pack stack has lost 5 of its 10 charges, so the trial staff gets a 2-charge share (5/2) instead of 5; that addition scores below the first trial (replacing the scroll, home power 9,914), and the Borg sets out to buy the Word of Recall back out of the home. Corrected: the addition keeps its 5-charge share (home power 10,014) and the Borg stores a staff instead.
